rankings.shortfall_reason: Wave 2: Wave 1 took the four best-known wig specialists (Kinpatsu Cosplay, Cowbutt Crunchies, Hanie Comb, Epic Cosplay), so they cannot repeat here. The remaining candidates failed verification: Jannet Incosplay's primary page is gone (403), Dare Taylor's own wig video is titled 'Dare Taylor learns How to sculpt a wig!' (she is learning, not a stylist), and Ruka's Wigs has no independent corroborating public source beyond her own carrd. No other verifiable wig-focused maker was found after dedicated searches; reporting 4 of 6 honestly rather than padding.
